name: carbone
note: Two faces on the house contract since the light curation. The dark face is carbone as it always shipped — graphite canvas, bone ink, electric lime. The light face holds the same lime HUE at 95% of its chroma but at OKLCH L 0.50 (#037829), because the bright lime is 1.48:1 on an off-white canvas and cannot carry text; the bright value stays the brand axis and the spectrum ribbon. The code block is painted on --surface-inverse, which is dark on BOTH faces, so carbone's terminal register survives the flip. Before this, carbone declared 289 of 303 tokens identically across schemes and carried 14 strays with light arms tuned for a canvas it never presented.
